tasks.label: Build Debug Odroid
tasks.command: source /opt/poky/4.0.28/environment-setup-cortexa53-poky-linux && rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug . && cd build && make

tasks.label: Build Release Odroid
tasks.command: source /opt/poky/4.0.28/environment-setup-cortexa53-poky-linux && rm -rf build && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release . && cd build && make
